active_ingredient: Active Ingredient Pulsatilla pratensis 5X HPUS, Borax 5X HPUS, Calendula officinalis 5X HPUS, Olea europaea 5X HPUS.
purpose: Purpose For symptoms of intimate irritation; for symptoms of burning and discomfort; for symptoms of intimate discomfort.
indications_and_usage: Uses For the temporary relief of symptoms associated with: minor intimate irritation; minor burning, itching, and discomfort; intimate odor.
warnings: Warnings For vaginal use only. For adult use only. Do not use : if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, unless directed by a doctor if you have pelvic pain, fever, chills, or abnormal vaginal bleeding if you have unusual discharge with a foul odor if you have never had vaginal symptoms before if you are allergic to any ingredient in this product if the foil packet is damaged, torn, or previously opened Ask a doctor before use if you have : diabetes, a weakened immune system, or recurrent vaginal infections a serious medical condition or are under medical supervision symptoms that have lasted more than 7 days before starting use. When using this product : you may experience mild irritation at the application site. do not use tampons, douches, spermicides, or other vaginal products; this product may damage condoms and diaphragms and reduce their effectiveness. avoid contact with eyes. Stop use and ask a doctor if : symptoms do not improve within 3 days symptoms last more than 7 days symptoms worsen or return after completion new symptoms develop, including fever, pelvic pain, nausea, or unusual bleeding severe burning, swelling, or rash occurs at the application site. If pregnant or breastfeeding , ask a healthcare professional before use. Keep out of reach of children . If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away (1-800-222-1222).
dosage_and_administration: Directions Adults: insert one (1) suppository vaginally at bedtime. Use once daily for up to 7 consecutive nights. Do not use more than one suppository in any 24-hour period. Children under 18 years: do not use.
inactive_ingredient: Inactive Ingredients Aloe Vera Leaf Extract, Coconut (Cocos Nucifera) Oil, Saffron (Crocus Sativus) Extract, Yellow Cedar (Thuja Occidentalis) Extract, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Purified Water.
spl_unclassified_section: Other information Store at 20°C–25 °C (68°F–77 °F) excursions permitted to 15–30 °C (59–86 °F). Protect from direct heat and sunlight. Do not use if foil seal is broken, damaged, or previously opened.
